Married Elisabeth Mumpert at Altenstadt, by Wissembourg, on 10 September 1792; ten children,
among them Dominique, born 1807, who took the family to Ohio.
Died at Altenstadt 21 March 1814. Born at Altenstadt on 8 February 1770, daughter of Laurent Mumpert and Elisabeth
Chardon. She married Georges Fritz on 10 September 1792 and was widowed in 1814.
She died at Altenstadt in 1837; her son Dominique took the family to Ohio.
